settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteIntro: This can't be undone. When you delete your account:
settings.deletePoint1: Your profile, photos, listings, messages and booking history are deleted.
settings.deletePoint2: Your upcoming bookings are cancelled and your deposits are refunded.
settings.deletePoint3: Guests booked at your tables or markets are cancelled and refunded.
settings.deletePoint4: Signing in again later starts a brand-new, empty account.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: Everything above happens straight away and can't be undone.
settings.deletedBody: Your account has been deleted. Thanks for being part of Eatery.
settings.notifBookingsHelp: When you book or receive an order
settings.notifOffAsk: Notifications are off. Turn them on to hear about bookings, reminders and messages.
settings.notifOffDenied: Notifications are turned off for Eatery in your phone's settings.
settings.blockedIntro: People you block can't book your listings, message you or see yours.
settings.blockedEmptyBody: If you block someone from their profile, they show up here.
settings.unblockConfirmBody: They'll be able to see your listings and book with you again.
user.notFoundBody: This person may have deleted their account.
user.blockConfirmBody: They won't be able to book your listings or message you, and you won't see theirs. You can unblock them in Settings.
report.title: Report
report.heading: What's wrong?
report.intro: Reports are private. The person you report isn't told who sent it.
report.alsoBlockHelp: They won't be able to book with you or message you.
report.thanksBody: We review every report within 24 hours.
